formattedAddress: 10449, Taiwan, Taipei City, Zhongshan District, 中山區 Jinxi St, 31號1樓

displayName.text: COFFEE XOVER 咖啡手搖概念店

text.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
A treasure cafe with less fame

The signature black sandwich 🥪 is tasty beyond expectations and coffee also good

The vibe in the afternoon is chilling, with lots of students studying there. Excellent service, will definitely visit again 👍🏻

text.text:
I ordered a brown sugar latte and it was pretty good. The only sugar used is the brown sugar which was caramelized with a blow torch at the end and therefore it wasn’t overly sweet. The mochi was soft enough and worked well with the brown sugar.  The sandwich was okay but I thought that three slices of bread was excessive and they could have used better quality ingredients such as Romain lettuce instead of iceberg lettuce, better ham which was the same as any breakfast fast food shop and a thicker omelet. If it didn’t cost so much, I would think it was good but the price and what you get doesn’t really match.

The environment is clean and they have the first floor as well as the basement for seating. The staff is professional and courteous. They also play pop songs in a medium volume. This would be a good place for a meeting with coworkers. I didn’t see power plugs accessible so not a great place to work from.

text.text: Love this cafe's design and vibe. Everything is elegantly monochromatic black with touches of silver. Ordered iced osmanthus latte and a meat floss with cheese and egg sandwich. Happy with the food too.

text.text:
In Search Of: Best Coffee in Taipei - Taiwan

This spot just made it onto my favorites list for 2024! It’s awesome that the owner, Andy, personally came over to check if my drink was okay. Love his vibe and the concept behind his coffee brand. It leans toward the coffee side of the palate, but I absolutely love it. Stay tuned for more in-depth conversations with Andy!

Absolutely loved both drinks I tried:
• Guava Lemonade Four Seasons Oolong Tea – Better than some tea shops I’ve been to.
• 炙烤糰子拿鐵黑糖 (Mochi Latte) – Not too sweet, just perfect!

text.text: This cafe has an underground sitting. Nice setup with a book shelving backdrop, and soft music playing. Great place to meet friends for chit chat. The flat coffee is not too overpowering. Well bodied drink. Staff were friendly and explained the different coffee they have. They also have sandwiches. Overall great place for meeting people or just a place for reading.
